# Analyze the relationship between introduction pathways and mrt in invasion_success dataset
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Check the distribution of mrt across different introduction pathways
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='mrt', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time (mrt) by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Minimum Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.show()

# Check for statistical significance using ANOVA
from scipy.stats import f_oneway

# Filter out rows with missing values in 'mrt' and 'intro.pathway'
filtered_data = invasion_success.dropna(subset=['mrt', 'intro.pathway'])

# Group data by 'intro.pathway' and extract mrt values
groups = filtered_data.groupby('intro.pathway')['mrt'].apply(list)

# Perform ANOVA
f_statistic, p_value = f_oneway(*groups)
f_statistic, p_value

# Analyze the relationship between mrt, introduction pathways, and invasion success
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols

# Fit a linear model to examine the interaction between mrt and intro.pathway on invasion success
# Using 'number.of.invaded.plots' as a measure of invasion success
model = ols('number.of.invaded.plots ~ mrt * intro.pathway', data=invasion_success).fit()
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(model, typ=2)
anova_table

# Use pairwise comparisons to analyze the interaction between mrt and intro.pathway
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Filter out rows with missing values in 'mrt', 'intro.pathway', and 'number.of.invaded.plots'
filtered_data = invasion_success.dropna(subset=['mrt', 'intro.pathway', 'number.of.invaded.plots'])

# Group data by 'intro.pathway'
groups = filtered_data.groupby('intro.pathway')

# Perform pairwise t-tests between pathways
pathways = groups.groups.keys()
results = {}

for i in range(len(pathways)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(pathways)):
        pathway1 = pathways[i]
        pathway2 = pathways[j]
        group1 = groups.get_group(pathway1)['number.of.invaded.plots']
        group2 = groups.get_group(pathway2)['number.of.invaded.plots']
        t_stat, p_val = ttest_ind(group1, group2)
        results[(pathway1, pathway2)] = (t_stat, p_val)

results
